description.value: Uncle Sal's Shawarma is a family-run Mediterranean restaurant in Richmond, operated by the same family behind the Al Basha Richmond location since 2015. The menu centres on shawarma wraps and plates featuring lamb, beef, and falafel, all prepared to halal standards. It occupies a strip-mall unit on Blundell Road and pitches itself on consistent food quality and a warm, family-style atmosphere.
